notes.title: Our Game Is Coming Soon - Sharing Some Thoughts.
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this is the production team of the game "Masquerade"——[/p][p]Our game will be officially released tomorrow! Before this little work is officially introduced to everyone, I would like to say a few words to everyone——[/p][p]Disguise "is a small-scale text adventure game inspired by" fraud zones ". Although we have borrowed a special setting that exists in reality, the overall world is still fictional. We do not pursue curiosity or deliberately render darkness, but hope to tell a story about humanity, struggle, and redemption through such a background. The overall plot is relatively restrained, and the dark side is handled conservatively, without any overly uncomfortable content. In the end, it will also lead to a gentle ending - although not necessarily satisfactory to everyone, that is the direction we hope to convey.[/p][p]We are well aware that this subject matter itself is extremely niche, and there are almost no ready-made mature works of the same subject matter to refer to. Many settings can only be built by one's own imagination. This also means that it may be difficult to cover every logical detail in this work, but we strive to make the overall plot logic consistent. Please show some tolerance and try not to overthink or interpret as much as possible.[/p][p]Due to this being a completely zero funding project initiated by a non professional team, we do not have an outsourcing budget or industry guidance. All the plot, art, script, and implementation are completed by ourselves through trial and error. It can be said that this time is more like an attempt to tell a story that we find interesting. For this reason, it is difficult for this work to meet the standards of commercial or industry works in terms of technical presentation and detail polishing. We only hope that it can be treated gently as an attempt under a niche theme, and we sincerely request everyone to be more tolerant.[/p][p]We know that the use of standing art resources is one of the shortcomings of this time. The artistic quality and style of some characters are indeed unsatisfactory. In order not to destroy immersion, we have chosen to weaken the use of standing art in some scenes, hoping that everyone can pay more attention to the plot and music itself. We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused by this![/p][p]The game mainly revolves around the relationship between the male lead "Yang" and the female lead "Yue", with a certain degree of "favorability" system designed, but this is not a traditional emotional development game. We hope that everyone can understand this' growth curve 'as a process of gradually regaining conscience through guilt, pressure, and struggle, rather than a simple emotional path.[/p][p]Of course, this is just a small adventure designed by ourselves, not as exquisite as a movie, nor as profound as a novel. I hope everyone can play with ease, without taking it too seriously or interpreting it too much. We think this story is quite interesting, but we are also aware that it cannot satisfy everyone's taste and cannot withstand scrutiny.[/p][p]To show sincerity, the first release price of "Masquerade" is only 6 yuan, with a two-week discount of 4.8 yuan, which can be considered a cheap dessert. There's not much else to say, I hope you're willing to take some time to experience the story we've created with care.[/p][p]There are still many overlooked and interesting themes waiting to be explored on Earth, and AVG is a unique form that can tell wonderful stories. Regardless of the outcome of this work, we will continue to create in the future. Our next story is being planned, and we promise that it will be more mature, heartfelt, and accepted and liked by more people than this one![/p][p]Finally, thank you to every player who is willing to experience this story. It is your support and tolerance that gives us the courage to continue moving forward.[/p]

notes.title: 独立AVG游戏《伪装 Demo》上线！集齐全成就送CDKEY！
notes.content: [p]大家好！我们是一个小小的独立游戏制作组，这次带来了我们的首款作品——《伪装》。[/p][h3][b]Demo版本现已上架steam，欢迎下载试玩~[/b][/h3][p]这是一款以诈骗园区为灵感题材的AVG文字冒险游戏，你将扮演男主“阳”，作为园区的中层管理者，负责新来的“小猪”的管理、医疗和培训。[/p][p]在日复一日的工作中，你会遇到不同的人，也会逐渐察觉某些不寻常的细节。[/p][p]一名名叫“月”的女孩的出现，让你平静麻木的生活逐渐起了变化……[/p][p]在这个过程中，你将面临一系列抉择——[/p][p]是顺从规则继续冷漠下去，还是逐步唤回良知、改变命运？[/p][p]每一次选择，都会指向不同的结局。[/p][p]在游戏中，你会：[/p][p]· 体验一段夹杂着罪与救赎、挣扎与选择的沉浸式故事；[/p][p]· 与多位性格鲜明的人物展开复杂微妙的关系；[/p][p]· 面对良知与现实的碰撞，逐步改变自己的命运。[/p][h3][b]点击详细了解本游戏开发背景↓[/b][/h3][p][url="https://www.xiaoheihe.cn/app/bbs/link/155333405"]更多介绍：独立游戏《伪装》“诈骗园区”题材的悬疑类AVG，现已上架steam[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.xiaoheihe.cn/app/bbs/link/155438405"]更多介绍：【致所有关注《伪装》的朋友们】[/url][/p][h3][b]关于全成就送CDKEY活动[/b][/h3][p]为了感谢大家的支持，也鼓励更多玩家深入体验这段故事，我们特别开启了“全成就送CDKEY”的活动，规则如下：[/p][p]· 探索游戏，完成Demo中的所有12个成就；[/p][p]· 将全成就截图发送至邮箱：[/p][p][url="https://qwaygamers@163.com；"]qwaygamers@163.com；[/url][/p][p][/p][p]· 同时，我们十分期待您能在邮件里顺带附上对该Demo的评价！[/p][p]· 截止时间为：2025年6月25日23:59前；[/p][p]· 我们会一一回复，并赠送每位忠实玩家一份正式版游戏的CDKEY！[/p][p]· 如果参与人数远超预期（比如上千人…），我们可能要稍作调整，还请大家多多理解。[/p][p]· 不过说实话，以我们这个新人制作组的体量，这种概率还是非常渺茫的，所以大家大可放心，安心玩游戏、收集成就就好啦！[/p][h3][b]还有几句想说的[/b][/h3][p]· 本次“全成就送CDKEY”活动是正式版发售前的限时特别活动，我们希望通过这种方式，让更多人有机会完整体验我们的故事，这也是我们起步阶段，对愿意我们的故事的玩家的一份小小的感谢。[/p][p]· 如果你喜欢这款游戏、愿意多花时间探索剧情、收集全成就，那你便是我们制作组最需要回馈的人之一！[/p][p]· 当然，如果你未来愿意选择直接支持我们购买正式版，那无疑是对我们这个小团队最大的认可[/p][p]——无论哪一种方式支持，我们都感激不尽！[/p][p]· 正式版不会贵的！请大家放心，价格绝对会非常非常亲民；[/p][p]· 游玩后欢迎在steam平台多多留下反馈，我们会认真阅读每一条；[/p][p]· 如果你喜欢《伪装》，推荐给朋友就是对我们最大的支持；[/p][p]· 拿到CDKEY后，希望你在正式版里感受到我们给您带来的这份用心与热忱。[/p][p]感谢大家愿意给我们新人制作组这个机会！[/p][p]祝各位游戏愉快！[/p]

notes.title: To all friends who follow 'Masquerade'!
notes.content:
We are deeply touched to see so many friends willing to give us a chance. Everyone on the team feels incredibly warm.  

We notice that some players are still concerned about the art style. We want to be honest about the current situation: since *Masquerade* is completely self-funded, we temporarily cannot afford professional artists. Therefore, we have to adopt an AI-assisted creation plan. The character illustrations and CGs indeed struggle to match the expressiveness of professional artists' works. We fully understand the concerns of some players—this decision is truly a last resort. However, we promise to do our utmost to optimize the visual presentation within our current limitations.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635313/54a4883b6ec1c9a729920d75df1d972865f1df49.jpg[/img]  

Even so, there are players who are willing to listen to our story. Because of this, we are determined to finish this game. No matter the outcome, we must at least give an account to those who support us—even if the final product is not perfect, we will do our best to complete it!  

We especially want to thank those friends who are not averse to AI and have provided suggestions on the illustration style. It is true that the current二次元 (Japanese-style) art style seems somewhat incongruent with the theme. However, it should be noted that this game will not excessively depict the dark side of the scam park but will focus on portraying the characters' fates and emotional narratives. Therefore, using a二次元 visual style for expression should be acceptable.  

Of course, this is just our preliminary judgment, and the final decision will be based on everyone's actual experience. After the demo is released, we welcome everyone to share your thoughts freely. If the stylistic conflict is indeed obvious, we will actively adjust and optimize it in the official version!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635313/c68a71e4479ed65c3572ae4deacbad3c030e994d.jpg[/img]  

Additionally, I have noticed some misunderstandings about the plot in the comments:  
Although the game is set in a "scam park," the entire plot is a linear narrative centered on the male protagonist's personal destiny. To avoid misunderstandings, we specifically note that it is not a multi-branch cultivation game, and there will be no development like "seizing power to become the park boss."  

The entire game流程 (gameplay) is approximately 2-3 hours long. The setting is simple, and the scope is small—there is no grand world-building... (we apologize sincerely).  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635313/172c522d01df0d06ae50f3b38387df94ad896e03.jpg[/img]  

We are both moved and pressured to see that some people have high expectations of us, fearing that the final result will not meet everyone's expectations. After all, this theme was conceived on a whim, and due to its特殊性 (special nature), there are not many reference works of the same theme. We have to figure out many things step by step.  

Therefore, the depth of the plot is likely not very rich, and there will be many shortcomings, but we will focus on what we do well.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635313/30ab2314a258a60b332c261f1c651d53fe42bdf6.jpg[/img]  

Like many independent developers, we face severe limitations in time, manpower, and resources during our first game development. Without sufficient confidence and experience, we dare not invest too many resources rashly. We believe that for our first game, the most important thing is to "finish it" rather than pursue perfection from the start.  

We hope to accumulate experience and grow through this small-scale game. *Masquerade* will surely have many issues, whether in the script, art, or pacing, but we will improve step by step and do our best within our capabilities.  

This game is highly likely to struggle to gain recognition from most players in terms of plot or perception, so we will demonstrate our sincerity in other aspects—such as... price!  

Meanwhile, to ensure players can feel our sincerity, we have strive to expand the overall volume of the game. Currently, the total text has exceeded 100,000 words—although this is not much in the AVG (adventure game) field, we guarantee that it will be extremely cost-effective among AVGs of the same price range~!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635313/fdb87c98ccc07d29eb63a12457285530d6916de4.jpg[/img]  

In short, independent game development is a process of continuous trial and error and experience accumulation. We hope to lay a solid foundation through this practice. We look forward to bringing you more mature works in the future with the experience gained from *Masquerade*!  

Once again, thank you for your kind criticism and patience. The road ahead is long, and we hope we can gradually improve on this journey!
